topic: keep brown sugar from hardening into a solid block
core_question: How do I stop brown sugar from turning into a hard, unusable block in storage? (secondary: How do I get rid of weeds in my garden bed naturally?)
answer_summary: Keep brown sugar in an airtight container or bag with a piece of bread, an apple slice, or a marshmallow, which releases moisture into the sugar and keeps it soft.; after the topic shift: Pull existing weeds by the root, then spread a thick layer of mulch over the bed to block sunlight and suppress new weed growth.
